classification.rationale: Published content intended for everyone; no personal data.
classification.controls: Integrity of the bundle (HTTPS, build hashing).

classification.rationale: Descriptive catalogue attributes shown to all visitors.
classification.controls: Change control on the data file.

classification.element: Search text typed by the user
classification.rationale: Not stored or transmitted; could reveal dietary or personal interests if logged.
classification.controls: Do not log or send to third parties.

classification.rationale: Reveals a person's tastes; only the owner needs it.
classification.controls: Write limited to User role; clear on logout/shared devices.
Collect only with a lawful basis; never place on the ledger.

classification.location: Not implemented in the app ('No Notifications yet!!')
classification.rationale: Would describe a user's contact preferences.
classification.controls: Opt-in consent before any notification is sent.

classification.rationale: Controls what the interface shows; not sensitive alone but not for public display.
classification.controls: Replace with server-issued session/token in production.

classification.element: Blockchain ledger records (event type, recipe ID, pseudonymous actor ID, timestamp, hashes)
classification.rationale: Immutable behavioural records; pseudonymised personal data under GDPR; integrity is business-critical.
classification.controls: Hash-chain + consensus; read for Analyst/Admin only; no names on chain.

classification.rationale: Whoever holds the salt can link pseudonyms back to the actor.
classification.controls: Never exported; server-side secret store in production; rotate on erasure request.

classification.element: Access-control policy (role x module read/write matrix)
classification.rationale: Tampering allows privilege escalation across the whole application.
classification.controls: Editable only through the Security Configuration module (Admin domain); audit every change.

classification.rationale: Security-relevant evidence; may expose attack patterns.

classification.personal: Simulated now; Yes with real users
classification.rationale: Behavioural data about people if real users replace the simulation.
classification.controls: Anonymise/aggregate before sharing; restrict raw rows to Analyst.

classification.rationale: Internal analytics; aggregated, but not meant for the public.
classification.controls: Serve only to roles with AI Dashboards read access.

classification.rationale: Would grant account access if the app adds sign-in.

gdpr.requirement: Tell people what is processed and why.
gdpr.evidence: Data use is simple, but the Figma design has no privacy notice.
gdpr.action: Add a privacy notice reachable from About RecipeBox.

gdpr.requirement: Use data only for the stated purpose.
gdpr.evidence: Favourites and events are used only for saved recipes, integrity and recommendations.
gdpr.action: Keep purposes documented when features grow.

gdpr.evidence: No registration, no backend; the ledger stores only event type, recipe ID and a pseudonym.
Profile name is fixed text and cannot be corrected by the user.

gdpr.requirement: Do not keep data longer than necessary.
gdpr.evidence: localStorage has no expiry; ledger blocks are permanent.
gdpr.action: Add retention periods and a 'clear my data' action.

gdpr.requirement: Protect against tampering and unauthorised access.
gdpr.evidence: Hash-chained ledger detects tampering and RBAC limits modules, but enforcement is client-side and data is not encrypted at rest.
gdpr.action: Enforce RBAC on a server; encrypt sensitive stores.

gdpr.requirement: Have a lawful basis for processing.
gdpr.evidence: Processing is limited to features the user asks for, but the basis is not recorded.
gdpr.action: Document the basis (consent or legitimate interest).

gdpr.requirement: Consent must be explicit, informed and withdrawable.
gdpr.evidence: No consent mechanism exists (not in the design).
gdpr.action: Add consent before any non-essential processing (e.g. analytics).

gdpr.evidence: No privacy policy screen.
Favourites are visible in the Favourites screen; no full export.
Display name cannot be changed.
Favourites can be removed; ledger entries cannot be deleted, but hold only pseudonymous IDs (rotating the salt unlinks them).
gdpr.action: Add a 'delete my data' action that clears storage and rotates the salt.

gdpr.requirement: Provide data in a machine-readable format.
gdpr.evidence: No export function.
The model is trained on simulated data only.
gdpr.action: Re-assess before training on real user data.

gdpr.requirement: No solely automated decisions with significant effects.
gdpr.evidence: Recommendations have no legal or similar effect.

gdpr.principle: Data protection by design and default
gdpr.evidence: Minimal data, local-only storage, pseudonymisation on the ledger, role-based access.

gdpr.requirement: Maintain a record of processing activities.
gdpr.evidence: The Data Classification sheet works as a register but lacks controller details.
Integrity and access controls exist; no authentication, no encryption at rest.
No incident-response procedure.
No real personal data is processed yet.
gdpr.action: Perform a DPIA before launch with real users.

gdpr.evidence: No app data leaves the device, but Inter is loaded from Google Fonts, which sends visitors' IP addresses to Google.
